answer: Resist a gale of fake signups with escalating admission bonds. Each identity locks 20 POA for 21 days and must pass three audit rounds, 72 hours apart, where a public randomness beacon picks five established verifiers. One person pays 20 POA once; a farm pays per identity, and the bond doubles for every extra identity traced to the same funding vine: 20, 40, 80, 160 POA, all frozen simultaneously. Verifiers re-check the lock, timestamps, and work samples on-ledger; failing two rounds slashes 50% and ejects the identity.
